- You asked for our SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), and whether we can provide a bridge letter if the current report is older than 12 months.
- You also mentioned Medicore prefers artifacts uploaded to your Trust Portal and a completed vendor security questionnaire.
- Next actions we suggest:

  2) Please confirm the best security contact and the Trust Portal upload link/email.
  3) We’ll complete the vendor security questionnaire and send a bridge letter (if needed).

Thanks Jordan — appreciated the session. 

Quick answers and asks from my side:
- Medicore needs the latest SOC 2 Type II report. If the report is >12 months old we need either a bridge letter or an interim attestation.
- Please complete the attached vendor security questionnaire (we use a short VSQ for faster intake).
- Preferred upload is our Trust Portal: https://trustportal.medicore.com/upload — I can generate a one-time upload token if you tell me the uploader email.

Security contact is security@medicore.com; my security lead (cc'd here) will validate artifacts. Also include a DPA/GDPR contact for legal to kick off the paperwork.

I’ve attached the VSQ template. Let me know if you want the questionnaire pre-filled by your team or if you prefer that we send it to an internal reviewer.

Thanks,

Looping internal owners in — forwarding Alex's note. Action items I recommend without waiting for procurement:

- Ben: take point on completing the vendor questionnaire and uploading artifacts to Medicore's Trust Portal once Alex generates the one-time token. I attached our intake checklist and a short script for what to include in the upload.
- Jordan: please confirm the uploader email (I'd suggest security@redwood.com) so Alex can generate the token. Also confirm whether we have a bridge letter ready or if we need a quick attestation from the compliance team.
- Dylan (CS): please open a case to hold the onboarding timeline (24-48h artifact handoff → security review → procurement review). We should track this in the deal timeline.

If we can get the VSQ completed and the SOC 2 PDF + bridge letter uploaded by end of day tomorrow (29 Apr), we’ll aim to have Medicore's procurement start legal/contract review by Monday.
